(()=>{
'use strict';
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=1200,H=750,keys=new Set();
const colors={ink:'#172326',deep:'#10191d',steel:'#304247',line:'#526368',cream:'#f2f0e5',muted:'#a8b8b2',lime:'#d7ef65',orange:'#f18b56',cyan:'#73d5d0',red:'#e75e50'};
let mode='title',last=0,elapsed=0,score=0,stops=0,misses=0,toast='',toastTime=0,shake=0;
const player={x:600,y:602,vx:0,vy:0,face:0,carried:null,interactLock:0,anim:0};
const cars=[{name:'ARIA 07',color:'#f06d4d',number:'07',next:5,stops:0,crew:'#e28e64'},{name:'NOVA 22',color:'#68b6b0',number:'22',next:22,stops:0,crew:'#73c5b6'}];
let active=null,taskQueue=[],jobIndex=0,jobTime=0,jobLimit=33,carAnim=0,flashes=[],particles=[],clock=0,pausedFrom='';
const stations={tires:{x:448,y:311,label:'TIRE STACK',icon:'tire'},fuel:{x:750,y:310,label:'FUEL RIG',icon:'fuel'},tools:{x:600,y:290,label:'TOOL WALL',icon:'tools'}};
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
function rr(c,x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke=null,lw=1){c.beginPath();c.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);if(fill){c.fillStyle=fill;c.fill()}if(stroke){c.lineWidth=lw;c.strokeStyle=stroke;c.stroke()}}
function txt(t,x,y,size,color=colors.cream,weight=600,align='left',spacing=0){ctx.font=`${weight} ${size}px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif`;ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.textAlign=align;ctx.textBaseline='middle';if(spacing){ctx.letterSpacing=`${spacing}px`}ctx.fillText(t,x,y);ctx.letterSpacing='0px'}
function line(x1,y1,x2,y2,color,width=1){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.stroke()}
function circle(x,y,r,fill,stroke=null,lw=1){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill();if(stroke){ctx.lineWidth=lw;ctx.strokeStyle=stroke;ctx.stroke()}}
function roundedPanel(x,y,w,h,fill='#10191ddd',stroke='#ffffff22'){rr(ctx,x,y,w,h,10,fill,stroke)}
function draw(){
 ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);drawWorld();drawGarage();drawStations();drawPitLane();drawCrowd();drawPlayer();drawEffects();drawHUD();
 if(mode==='title')drawTitle();else if(mode==='paused')drawPause();else if(mode==='over')drawGameOver();
}
function drawWorld(){
 let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);g.addColorStop(0,'#26363a');g.addColorStop(.52,'#344448');g.addColorStop(1,'#192529');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 // concrete texture, kept subtle and deliberate
 for(let i=0;i<46;i++){let x=(i*173+27)%W,y=(i*97+53)%H;circle(x,y,1+(i%3)*.35,i%2?'#ffffff0b':'#07101312')}
 // back wall and roof edge
 ctx.fillStyle='#182427';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,54);ctx.fillStyle='#415358';ctx.fillRect(0,53,W,4);
 for(let x=28;x<W;x+=74){line(x,0,x+28,53,'#ffffff08',1)}
 // floor divisions and drain strips
 for(let x=23;x<W;x+=120){line(x,70,x,413,'#d7e2d514',1)}
 ctx.fillStyle='#121b1e';ctx.fillRect(0,414,W,3);ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff12';ctx.fillRect(0,417,W,2);
 for(let x=18;x<W;x+=48){ctx.fillStyle='#82908d36';ctx.fillRect(x,433,24,2)}
 // ground marks
 for(let x=0;x<W;x+=12){ctx.fillStyle=x%24?'#e5e9d8':'#171f21';ctx.fillRect(x,681,12,24)}
 ctx.fillStyle='#e7e6d9';ctx.fillRect(0,680,W,4);ctx.fillStyle='#121b1e';ctx.fillRect(0,707,W,43);
 // lane edge lines and pit box
 line(0,531,W,531,'#e8e7d0',2);line(0,655,W,655,'#e8e7d0',2);
 ctx.setLineDash([18,16]);line(0,594,W,594,'#e8e7d044',2);ctx.setLineDash([]);
 // center bay boundary
 ctx.fillStyle='#d7ef6512';ctx.fillRect(417,423,366,244);ctx.strokeStyle='#d7ef6560';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(417,423,366,244);
 for(let i=0;i<9;i++){ctx.fillStyle=i%2?'#e9eadb':'#151d20';ctx.fillRect(420+i*40,657,40,9)}
 // side team box lane markings
 ctx.strokeStyle='#ffffff17';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.strokeRect(30,432,330,225);ctx.strokeRect(870,432,300,225);
}
function drawGarage(){
 const bays=[{x:0,w:390,name:'SCUDERIA VELA',accent:'#e66f55',team:'01'}, {x:405,w:390,name:'NORTHSTAR RACING',accent:colors.lime,team:'YOU'}, {x:810,w:390,name:'KITE MOTORSPORT',accent:'#67b7b0',team:'03'}];
 for(let i=0;i<bays.length;i++){
  const b=bays[i];
  ctx.fillStyle=i===1?'#243235':'#222e31';ctx.fillRect(b.x,58,b.w,354);
  // roof/beam structure
  ctx.fillStyle='#151f22';ctx.fillRect(b.x,58,b.w,24);
  ctx.fillStyle=b.accent;ctx.fillRect(b.x,80,b.w,4);
  for(let px=b.x+18;px<b.x+b.w;px+=130){ctx.fillStyle='#46565a';ctx.fillRect(px,94,7,310);ctx.fillStyle='#182225';ctx.fillRect(px+7,94,4,310)}
  // workshop back wall
  ctx.fillStyle='#1c292c';ctx.fillRect(b.x+14,105,b.w-28,119);
  // wall panel rectangles
  for(let px=b.x+26;px<b.x+b.w-25;px+=55){ctx.fillStyle='#26373a';ctx.fillRect(px,116,43,94);line(px+7,121,px+7,203,'#ffffff0d',1)}
  // sign
  rr(ctx,b.x+22,92,190,28,5,'#10191d','#ffffff18');txt(b.name,b.x+34,106,11,b.accent,800,'left',1.2);
  // cabinets, work lights
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){let x=b.x+38+k*112;rr(ctx,x,229,74,63,4,'#314247','#607174');ctx.fillStyle='#152024';ctx.fillRect(x+6,236,62,4);for(let z=0;z<3;z++)circle(x+14+z*20,270,3,'#f0aa53')}
  // overhead lamp glow
  for(let k=0;k<4;k++){ctx.fillStyle='#f6d98b0a';ctx.fillRect(b.x+44+k*86,214,44,3)}
  // tool counter

  // signage plate on back
  rr(ctx,b.x+b.w-82,92,57,28,4,'#10191d','#ffffff17');txt(b.team,b.x+b.w-53,106,12,b.accent,800,'center',1);
 }
 // bright central ceiling light patch
 let glow=ctx.createRadialGradient(600,280,10,600,280,270);glow.addColorStop(0,'#e7ecc814');glow.addColorStop(1,'#e7ecc800');ctx.fillStyle=glow;ctx.fillRect(330,80,540,310);
}

## Objective
- Build a complete, polished, playable pit crew game where the player is the sole crew member in the middle garage, servicing two racing cars alongside fully staffed neighboring garages.

## Requirements
- Player moves around to fetch and fit tires, fuel, and other pit-service items.
- Two cars race and arrive for pit stops; the player must manage them.
- Make the game visually appealing and avoid an “AI slop” look.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML canvas game with custom-drawn garage, cars, crew, stations, and HUD; no external assets or dependencies.
- Game round lasts 120 seconds; late pit stops count toward a three-miss limit.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable game in `index.html` with title screen, movement, click/tap movement, E/space interactions, randomized service orders, scoring, pause, and end-game/replay.
- Added three garage bays, staffed neighboring crews, tire/fuel/tool stations, two cars, service timer, and status UI.
- Fixed missing `drawGarage` and `drawCrowd` definitions found during browser checks.
- Verified script syntax with `node --check` and browser console reports no errors.
- Captured and inspected the latest title-screen JPEG at `/tmp/opencode/last-call-title.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally test a full gameplay interaction loop in the browser, including service order completion and game-over behavior.
2. Review final `index.html` changes and provide a concise completion note with controls and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser page is `http://localhost:3002/`.
- Controls shown in game: WASD/arrows to move, E/space to interact, Esc to pause; clicking/tapping targets moves the character and interacts.
